description:
What is inside a Quark or PikPak share: its folders and files, with sizes. Lists only: downloads
        nothing and uses no free file.

        `download` of a share with folders or several files answers "pick_required" with a `share_id` and the top
        of the share. Open a folder with that `share_id` and the folder's id as `folder_id` (or start here with
        `url`). Then call `download` with the url, the `share_id` and the `file_id` of ONE file.

folder_id.description: With share_id: the id of the folder to open
folder_id.title: Folder Id

page.description: A later page of a long folder (next_page)
page.title: Page

password.description: Extraction code / password, if the share has one
password.title: Password

share_id.description: From pick_required or an earlier list_files: to open a folder
share_id.title: Share Id

url.description: A Quark or PikPak share link (without share_id)
url.title: Url

name: list_files
title: List the files in a share
